title: Proposal Contract v1.0 (Proposal Router object)
description: The proposal object that live_loop's Proposal Router gathers, dedupes, ranks, and delivers as owner cards. This contract ADOPTS the shape that already exists in code (legs/leg.py Proposal.to_dict + live_loop normalization + callback meta) and ADDS the P0 lead fields (consent snapshot, source_channel, lead linkage) so the ~80%-assembled internal measurement arc is FED, not reinvented. A proposal is propose-only: it carries zero approval authority, zero send capability; every external effect still requires owner verdict -> LANGAR append -> EffectorGate release.

schema_version.description: Optional (existing emitters do not set it); new P0 emitters MUST set it.

proposal_id.description: Existing grammar: 'P-'+uuid4.hex[:12] (legs/leg.py:189) and 'P-'+sha[:12] (lead_outcome_recorder.py:60). Correlates verdicts, outcome events, and (later) effect records.

leg_id.description: Emitting leg. 'lead' for the P0 lead legs (lead_outcome_recorder.py:92).

kind.description: Canonical kinds. 'draft_quote' is the EXISTING code value (lead_leg.py:112) — LEG_P0-2's 'quote_draft' spelling is superseded (code wins). 'first_response' and 'clarify_request' are NEW for P0-1/P0-2. 'report'/'draft_message' are pre-existing leg kinds (leg.py:80).

draft_only.description: Structural marker (lead_leg.py:110). Required for all draft kinds via allOf.

external_send_allowed.description: If present, MUST be false. No proposal can carry send permission.

attribution_id.description: Money-attribution carrier printed on quotes (attribution.py:64-65; lead_leg.py:98).

lead_id.description: Lead linkage. The router propagates payload.attribution_id or payload.lead_id into verdict records — never invented (live_loop.py:375-377).

total_incl_gst.description: Scalar at payload top level (router metric key, live_loop.py:321-324); [lo,hi] inside payload.breakdown (lead_quote.py:145,173).

price_range_aud.description: [lo, hi] rounded to 2dp (lead_leg.py:100). Ranges only — a proposal never fixes a final price; that is the Owner's decision.

intake.description: QuoteIntake.to_dict shape (pricing.py:85-133). Enums enforced fail-soft by the dataclass itself: area_type interior|exterior|both; prep_level minimal|standard|heavy; access_type ladder|scaffold|swing_stage; segment residential|strata|pm|builder|commercial; paint_quality standard|premium|trade; timeline asap|flexible|fixed_date.

channel.description: first_response target channel (reply on the channel the lead used — LEG_P0-1).

message_draft.description: first_response draft text. SMS drafts additionally obey the 320-char + STOP-line rule at render time (LEG_P0-1 prompt contract).

hash.description: sha256 of canonical JSON, first 24 hex (leg.py:90-95). Router dedupe key prefers hash, falls back to proposal_id (live_loop.py:250-251).

correlation_id.description: Lead correlation (live_loop.py:373; verdict default 'prop_<pid>' at verdict_recorder.py:69 when absent).

lead_id.description: Top-level convenience copy; router source of truth is payload.attribution_id || payload.lead_id (live_loop.py:377).

source_channel.description: Origin channel of the underlying candidate, carried so EffectorGate can hard-block synthetic_test BY TYPE without a store lookup. Runtime rule (cannot be expressed in schema): any effect request whose proposal has source_channel=synthetic_test is refused at EffectorGate unconditionally.

consent.description: Immutable snapshot copied from the lead candidate at draft time (NEW — zero code today, RUNTIME-TRUTH section 0). Lets the router and gate enforce the firewall locally.

verdict.description: 'deferred' is NOT a decision — the card stays open and single-use is not consumed (live_loop.py:436-446). 'edited_approved' is NEW (no button today; see x-compat).

source.description: Truncated to 40 chars in storage (verdict_recorder.py:79). Known values today: 'tg-proposal-button' (default, verdict_recorder.py:48), 'ari-button' (live_loop.py:452), 'ari' (live_loop.py:412).

value_aud_claimed.description: CLAIM only, and only meaningful on approved — forced to 0 for rejected/deferred (verdict_recorder.py:71-72); NEVER confirmed revenue (outcome_store.py:142-143 pins confirmed_revenue_aud=0.0).

callback_token.description: sha256(proposal_id)[:16] (live_loop.py:301-305); scheme 'prop:' deliberately separate from money 'app:' so it can never hit the settle path (live_loop.py:308-315).

edited_text.description: Present only for edited_approved; the diff feeds prompt tuning (blueprint section 11 phase 6).

measurement_event.description: The EXISTING durable record a verdict becomes (outcome_store row). Included for reference so P0 implementers write byte-compatible rows.

x-invariants: Propose-only: this object carries no approval, no send, no settle capability. Approval is a separate human event a leg cannot forge (leg.py:73-77 D5).

Single-use first-decision-wins: one decisive verdict per proposal; replayed Telegram callbacks are no-ops (live_loop.py:435-446); durable write is additionally idempotent (verdict_recorder.py:14-15,70).
A verdict may NEVER generate delivered/settled/failed/verified events (verdict_recorder.py:32-33).
value fields are asking-price CLAIMS for metrics/ranking only (live_loop.py:318-325); confirmed revenue exists only via attribution reconcile (attribution.py:105-120).
synthetic_test proposals traverse the FULL internal pipeline (card, verdict, outcome) but are hard-blocked at EffectorGate by type — runtime enforcement, declared here via source_channel.

Consent firewall at draft time: market_signal snapshot => kind restricted to report/clarify_request; first_response/draft_message require outreach_allowed=true; suppression is checked BEFORE drafting (SPEC section 2).
